candidate_policy: Reuse the exact candidate tree frozen in the sample-1 tournament without edits.
input_policy: Reuse the exact five cases, two reviewer families, and ten frozen base reviews from sample 1. Each audit runs in a fresh session and may not inspect another candidate or experiment output.

diagnostic_only.known_description_miss: Track whether a built-in-review audit recovers the unreachable existing-description fallback defect; do not make one historical root cause the sole usefulness gate.

decision_policy.behavior_passed_mechanics_failed: Preserve semantic reasoning and redesign deterministic parent-side evidence assembly.
decision_policy.both_passed: Advance to a fresh-PR comparison of the unchanged and mechanically simplified candidates.
